metadata.title: Urban Gritty Portrait with Damask Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, muscular male portrait centered against a light grey damask background, featuring aggressive black ink-splatter outlines that trace the subject's physique, paired with heavy, blocky typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Organic ink splatters contrasting with the rigid damask pattern
High-specular highlights on skin against matte background textures
Massive, heavy-weight typography balancing the central figure
Aggressive gestural lines reinforcing the subject's physical presence
coreInvariants: Black ink-splatter outlines on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-full shot of a muscular male figure, occupying roughly 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's torso and face, emphasized by high-contrast lighting and ink outlines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the muscular torso following the ink lines, then jumps to the large block text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Light grey damask pattern provides a textured but breathable negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey and white (background and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (ink splatters, shadows, and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin highlights and ink shadows; low saturation background vs. high saturation text accents.
paletteRestrictions: Primary blue and metallic gold for text

letterConstructionRules: Heavy blue outlines on gold fills
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are significantly larger than letters
Sub-title features a distressed, hand-painted brush script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif paired with a chaotic, aggressive brush script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the primary text.
Captures the aggressive, painted look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a muscular man with oiled skin, centered. Apply a light grey damask pattern to the background. Overlay aggressive, gestural black ink splatters and sketchy lines that follow the contours of his muscles and clothing.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked, extra-bold condensed sans-serif text in the top right corner. Use a gold fill with a thick royal blue outline. Below it, add a smaller subtitle in a dark blue, aggressive brush-style script.

verificationChecks: Is the ink splatter effect following the body contours?
Is the damask pattern subtle enough to not distract from the subject?
Does the typography have a thick blue border?
Is the lighting on the skin high-contrast with bright highlights?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the heavy outline.
Check that ink splatters don't obscure the face.
Verify the damask pattern is visible in the highlights.
Confirm the gold/blue color contrast is vibrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Ink Contour Overlay + Damask Background + Heavy Outlined Block Text
